contents:
The very first geocaching event from GeoNord took place during the weekend of August 29, 2015, and gathered about 600 participants from all over Europe.
During our event on the theme of Earth, geology, and Earthcaches, our participants got he opportunity to (re)discover the mining heritage of the Nord-Pas-de-Calais region at the Mining Historical Center of Lewarde in the North of France. More than half of the present geocachers visited on the guided tour the mining complex and museum.
For this first edition, we are offering several new features such as Carbo, our 2015 mascot, and VIP packs, which will quickly become the trademark of GeoNord.
 
Links:
Event Roadbook

In July 2016, we headed to the forest of Saint Amand Les Eaux for the MEGA event Retour aux Sources (Back to the Roots), focused on the theme of water and bringing together 2,000 people of 14 different nationalities.
Retour aux Sources is the very first GeoNord event to obtain MEGA status. The success of the Labcaches and the creation of the first 3D geocoin attracted everyone’s attention, not to mention the VIP packs, which sold out in just a few days. This second edition was not only bigger in terms of participants, but also in terms of excitement.
 
Links:
Earthcache Roadbook

The third edition of the GeoNord MEGA events, called Oxygen, took place from June 9 to 11, 2017. This event was held at the Saint-Omer airfield and at La Coupole d’Helfaut. The theme? Air!
Oxygen is an event packed with thrills, including a headlamp tour of the Eperlecques bunker and 20 Labcaches provided by Groundspeak, a first for a MEGA Event. Nearly 2,000 people of 20 different nationalities traveled to the North of France for this third edition.
Links:
Geocaching Blog GeoNord 2017 - a breath of fresh air Wherigos Tuto

Sunset, the fourth edition of GeoNord events, took place in Dunkirk and Leffrinckouke from July 12 to 15, 2018, with the theme of fire. What was supposed to be the last edition was very emotional for the members of the organization. Twenty Labcaches, VIP packs packed with goodies and sold online within hours of release, the appearance of collector’s boxes of the four elements “made in GeoNord,” the secret mission of the travel tags, a visit to the fort in the dunes, more than 2,500 people… everything was there, even the sun, which visited us for the fourth time.
More than 1,000 people attended, and your smiles over the years have motivated the team to continue writing the history of GeoNord events in 2022 with surprises never seen before!

After celebrating the four elements (earth, water, air, and fire) for four years in a row and taking a well-deserved break, we are back for a new chapter from July 13 to 17, 2022, at Olhain Departmental Park!
For the occasion, the GeoNord team is preparing five days filled with activities, geocaching, and events. As usual, we are creating beautiful products, geocoins, T-shirts, and entry packs that are affordable for as many people as possible. We are privatizing the entire campground and park accommodations to host many participants in the “Signal Village.” We are planning activities for as many people as possible and offering discounted ticket packs for park activities such as zip-lining, four-season sledding, mini-golf, suspended nets, and even the swimming pool.
Finally, GeoNord, in collaboration with Geocaching HQ, is building a new GPS MAZE ADVENTURES exhibition to offer you the opportunity to visit the GPS Maze exhibition for the first time in France. Many geocachers will be making the trip so as not to miss the opportunity to be with us and get the new icon!
To this date, GeoNord Is a Great Adventure still holds the attendance record for the biggest ever Geocaching event in France, thank you to all the participants!

In 2025, the GPS MAZE returns to France, and it is in the heart of Champagne in partnership with the Geocachers of Champagne that we will invite you to discover an ever more fun and interactive exhibition full of new interactive games and surprises!
The GPS Adventures Maze exhibition will be open to the public the weeked on May 31st, 2025 and it will takes place near the Block Party Event GeoCircus.

We are delighted to announce that the third GPS Maze in France will be held on May 15 and 16, 2026, in the heart of Vaucelles Abbey, as part of the Mega ⚔️🛡️🏰 Au blason !🏰🛡️⚔️
GeoNord, in partnership with Geocaching HQ and the GéHautsCaching team, invites you to discover an ever-more fun and interactive exhibition, packed with new features, and to participate in our new activity, “the Time Maze”, for a surprise!
You can contact us at contact@geonordelements.com or via the Geocaching messaging center.
title: Contact

contents:
GPS Maze Adventures, what is that? A GPS MAZE is a special and rare type of event-related cache. This is a traveling educational exhibit in the shape of a maze designed to teach people of all ages about GPS technology and Geocaching. The Maze will offer you to immerse yourself in the history of geocaching through a playful maze. During the visit of the exhibition, participate in the activities, solve riddles and don’t miss the opportunity find the 10 special Maze Labcaches.
What can we found in this maze? Explanatory panels on the types of caches, information on trackables, how to make a “night-cache”, learn about T5 caches in complete safety, interactive elements, etc., everything you always wanted to know about Geocaching as well as more surprises!
Will we get the “GPS Maze” cache icon after visiting the exhibition? Yes, this icon will be assigned to you after you have logged your “Attended” on the GPS Maze listing.
Do I need anything to visit the exhibition? No, just a little patience to get in line (if there is any queue) before you can access the Maze.
Will there be labcaches? Yes, and aventure of 10 special Maze Labcaches will be available inside the exhibition.
Will the exhibition be in French only? No, although most of the information will be in French, some panels and info will also be translated into English. Non-French-speaking people can get a guidebook in English at the entrance of the exhibition.
When can we visit the exhibition? The dates and times of opening of our GPS MAZE are on the event listing page on the Geocaching website.

title: GPS Maze Adventures - France

contents:
At the end of 2014, we launched the GeoNord adventure based on the theme of the four elements. Between 2015 and 2018, we organized three to four days of events each year to promote the heritage of the Nord-Pas-De-Calais region. What was supposed to be a fairly large gathering each year eventually became an unmissable event for French and foreign geocachers alike. It was so successful that each year we broke our own record for the largest geocaching event ever organized in France!
After a break of a few years and the COVID-19 pandemic, we returned in 2022 for a 5-day weekend for a MEGA event and the very first GPS MAZE ADVENTURES in France, entirely designed from scratch by us.
Since then, we have been offering other MEGA event organizing teams the opportunity to host the GPS MAZE as well.
title: History
